outputs: answers to visual questions using external knowledge

changes_made.explanation: No changes needed. The paper clearly addresses NLG tasks through answer generation for visual questions and uses image captioning as part of the pipeline.

Consolidated metric names - 'Open-domain accuracy based on STE' and 'Open-domain accuracy' both refer to the same STE-based evaluation method. Kept 'Sentence Textual Entailment (STE)' as the canonical name since this is the core metric used for open-domain evaluation.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is used in this paper. The models mentioned (LXMERT, BERT, RoBERTa) are used for generation/retrieval tasks, not for post-hoc evaluation of outputs.
The paper does not conduct any human evaluation. All evaluations are performed using automatic metrics (precision, recall, accuracy, STE).

overall_notes: The paper focuses on knowledge-based visual question answering with a retriever-reader pipeline. While it involves natural language generation (answer generation), the primary focus is on retrieval and answer prediction rather than pure NLG evaluation methodology. The metrics used are standard VQA evaluation metrics adapted for open-domain settings.
